query:
INSERT INTO factory_layouts (workshopId, layoutLevel, name, layoutType, width, height, isActive)
SELECT id, 'WORKSHOP', CONCAT('Layout ', name), '2D', 1000, 800, true
FROM workshops 
WHERE (name LIKE '%SMT%' OR name LIKE '%Testing%')
AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM factory_layouts fl WHERE fl.workshopId = workshops.id);
